title: Youth Leadership Summit
description: A dynamic gathering of young leaders from across the LA Area for teaching, mentorship, and vision casting. All youth aged 13-35 are invited.

title: Area Women's Conference
description: An area-wide gathering of women for worship, teaching, testimonies, and fellowship. A celebration of sisterhood in Christ.

title: Men's Breakfast & Fellowship
description: Monthly men's breakfast with fellowship, a shared meal, and a word for the month. All men are welcome.

title: Sunday Service Times Changed
description: Please note: Starting October 1st, Sunday morning services will begin at 9:00 AM instead of 10:00 AM across all assemblies. Please plan accordingly.

title: Children's Christmas Carol & Party
description: Our annual Children's Christmas celebration with carols, drama, games, and treats. Children will lead the celebration!
